About

BEKASI, INDONESIA

I'm an Informatics Engineering student with a strong interest in IoT engineering and embedded systems — the layer where hardware, firmware, and software meet.

I like building things that respond to the real world: reading a sensor, deciding what it means, and doing something useful with that reading — whether that's raising an alarm, logging a value, or serving it over a network. My work so far spans ESP32-based sensor systems, Linux network services, and web applications.

I'm eager to keep learning, and I work well both independently and as part of a team.

Projects

2026 · FINAL PROJECT

Real-time fire detection and monitoring system using ESP32, DHT11, MQ-2, Flame Sensor, Firebase Realtime Database, and a web dashboard.

ESP32DHT11MQ-2Firebase
PROJECT DETAILS / SYSTEM BREAKDOWN

Smart Fire Detector Monitoring System is an IoT project built around an ESP32. The system reads temperature and humidity through DHT11, gas concentration through MQ-2, and fire presence through a Flame Sensor.

Sensor data is processed by the ESP32 and sent to Firebase Realtime Database, then displayed on a web dashboard for real-time monitoring. A 16×2 I2C LCD provides local status information, while a buzzer and red/green LEDs provide warning indicators.

MICROCONTROLLERESP32
DATABASEFirebase RTDB
TEMP. ALERT> 36°C
GAS ALERT> 4000 ppm
OUTPUTLCD · Buzzer · LED

2026 · NETWORKING PROJECT

Linux-based infrastructure project integrating DNS resolution with a web server, tested through a virtualized Ubuntu Server environment.

Ubuntu ServerBIND9NginxMySQL
PROJECT DETAILS / SYSTEM BREAKDOWN

Implementation of DNS for Web Server based Project is a networking and server-administration project focused on allowing users to access a hosted website through a domain name instead of directly using an IP address.

The project uses Ubuntu Server in Oracle VirtualBox, with BIND9 configured as the DNS server and Nginx as the web server. The implementation covers DNS configuration, web server configuration, client access testing, and network management.

VIRTUALIZATIONOracle VirtualBox
SERVER OSUbuntu Live Server
DNS SERVERBIND9

CORE TASKDomain Resolution + Hosting
2026 · MOBILE APP PROJECT

Android travel booking prototype with authentication, flight search, seat selection, booking flow, and digital ticket generation.

KotlinAndroid StudioFirebase
PROJECT DETAILS / SYSTEM BREAKDOWN

Booking Travel Ticket App is a mobile-based travel booking prototype developed with Kotlin in Android Studio. The app is designed around core online travel agency features such as user authentication, ticket search, booking management, and payment processing.

The booking flow lets users choose origin, destination, passengers, departure date, and travel class, then compare available flights. After selecting a flight, users can choose seats and receive a digital ticket containing travel details, QR code, and barcode for check-in.

LANGUAGEKotlin

BACKENDFirebase
BOOKING FLOWSearch · Select · Confirm
OUTPUTDigital Ticket + QR/Barcode
